storage: about 6 months; freezer: up to a year. Chop only just before use, as chopped pista loses colour and aroma fast.
looksLike: Small, elongated kernels about 1–1.5 cm long, bright to olive green inside with a thin purple-brown papery skin in patches. Sold out of the shell as "pista giri" or "plain pista kernels".
shelfLife: About 6–12 months in a sealed pack; 1–3 months once opened at room temperature.

usedIn.raw: 4 g (5–6 pistachios, unsalted, chopped), sprinkled on top just before eating
